tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcu gcig zhal lha lnga'i rjes gnang go bde don tshang bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo ki shwa rā ya/ rigs drug spyi dang gangs can mgon/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang la btud nas/ /bcu gcig zhal can lha lnga yi/ /rjes gnang go bde don tshang 'bri/ /'dir bcu gcig zhal lha lnga'i rjes gnang stong ra chos rje kun dga' legs grub kyis mdzad pa de cung go dka' bas go bde don tshang chos rje'i gsung gi gsal byed ni/ gzhi bzang po'i steng du maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga bkod/ de'i mthar mchod pa dang gtor ma phyag len bzhin bya/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu 'thor nas bsham/ mchod pa rnams oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs/ zhes rol mo dkrol/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la ༞dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ zhes ci nus/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs skyabs gsol spyi 'gre/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal lha lnga'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /gsum/ tshad med bzhi/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ ljang ser las pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du rang sems hrīḥyig dkar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhengs pa lang tsho dar la babs pa zhal bcu gcig rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas zhal ljang / g.yon zhal dmar/ de'i steng dbus ljang / g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng ma/ dbus dmar/ g.yas ljang / g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng ma khro zhal nag po khro gnyer dang bcas pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ de'i steng na zhi zhal dmar po gtsug tor dang bcas pa tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can mgrin pa cung zad dang bcas pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas bgrang phreng / gsum pas mchog sbyin/ bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas pad dkar yu ba dang bcas pa/ gsum pas ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dang dgu bcu go dgu yar dbu'i gtsug tor dang / mar pus mo'i lha nga las mi 'da' ba/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan/ dpung rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub ske rags se mo do shal la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs gsol ba/ 'dzum zhing zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs po tā la nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+rī bhā wa a bhi ṣīñtsa sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bhā wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/

thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang gi snying ka'i sngags phreng la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na bhu ha rā dza ya ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yaḥsamyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yaḥsamyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya lo ke shwa ra ya bo dhi sa twa ya ma hā sa twa ya/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ e ṭe wi ṭe tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su ma ba ti/ i li i li/ tsi ti dz+wa la ma pa na ye swāhā/ zhes gzungs ring tshar gcig gi rjes su/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra lan ci mang bzla/ 'di nas gshegs gsol gyi bar ma byas kyang rung / bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ oṃ ār+ya lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas shap+ta'i bar/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la satwaṃ/ zhes sogs lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / zhes sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa bdag la thim par gyur/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ ljang ser las zhes pa nas 'dzum zhing zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa zhes pa'i bar rang nyid ces pa dor ba ma gtogs gong ltar brjod/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi shar du mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam bzhag lhor trāṃ las rin 'byung ser po mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag nub tu oṃ las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/

byang du a las don yod ljang gu skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs po tā la nas 'phags pa gtso 'khor lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣīñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang rigs bzhi la so so'i dbu brgyan/ mchod pa rnams swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i zhes pa nas shap+ta'i bar oṃ ār+ya lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du mtshan sngags re re 'gor sbyar ba'i pā d+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar/ gtor ma rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin brlabs la/ oṃ dha ra dha ra sogs gsum gyis phul/ lo ke shwa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan 'di/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen por 'bul bar bgyi/ /bzhes nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mdun gyi lha la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa ci nus bya ba sngon du song nas slob ma rnams bos/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal lha lnga'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhus la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/

/snyam pas bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas sems ma yengs par nyon cig ces pa'i rjes su cho ga dngos la zhes pa la 'jug spro na thob par bya zhes pa'i rjes su/ de yang bdag cag rnams dal 'byor gyi lus thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blangs pas chog pa 'di shin tu skal ba bzang ba yin/ de lta bu'i skabs 'dir dal 'byor gyi lus la snying po blang dgos/ de'ang 'jig rten 'di'i bde skyid snyan grags rnams dang / 'jig rten phyi ma'i lha dang mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa ni zag bcas 'khor ba'i bde ba zhes bya ba snying po med pa nges par bslu ba'i chos can kho na yin pas blo bzang rnams kyis don du gnyer bya'i snying po ma yin/ 'o na ci zhig don du gnyer ba yin nam snyam na/ rang re rnams khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las thar dgos/ de yang bdag nyid gcig pu thar bas mi phan/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can thams cad kyis thog ma med pa'i 'khor ba nas 'khor bar/ bdag gi pha ma byas shing brtse gdung bsam gyis mi khyab pas yang yang bskyangs pa'i drin can sha stag yin/ des na drin can 'di rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god/ de'i nus pa bdag la da lta mi 'dug bdag las lhag pa 'jig rten na che ba tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa la yang mi 'dug 'o na su zhig la 'dug na rnams pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la mnga' ba 'dug pas bdag gis/ sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal lha lnga'i rjes su gnang ba zhus la/

thugs rje chen po'i lam nyams su blang bar bya snyam pa mdzod/ bsam pa de lta bu dang ldan pas sgo gsum gyi dge ba ci byas thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu myur du thob/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu'ang zhar las 'byung bas shin tu gal che ba yin/ cho ga dngos la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams da ci nas kyi gnas skabs su zin pa'i lugs su byas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal cig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin skyobs/ /khyod zhabs pad mo spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchi/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo mthu chen gyis/ /blo mchog bdag la stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas kha bskangs nas/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir rgyun bshags bya dgos pa yin pas/ sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag 'di la gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang dgos pas de la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas 'dir bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'phags pa thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig gtso 'khor lnga la sogs pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ni rten gyi stobs zhes bya ba yin/ de dag gi spyan sngar/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems drag po bskyed pa ni rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs zhes bya ba yin/ da phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi bgyid do snyam pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs zhes bya ba yin/ bshags pa byas pas sdig pa dag snyam pa'i dga' spro cung zad bsgoms pa ni sor chud pa'i stobs zhes bya ba yin pas/ de ltar stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags pa dang /

gzhan gyi dge ba la dga' zhing phrag dog med pa'i sgo nas rjes su yi rangs pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nye bar bstan pa'i stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can gyi don dam pa byang chub kyi sems tshul bzhin du bsgom par bgyi'o snyam du yi dam 'cha' ba dang / yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa dang / de'i ched du zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i lam la bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa'i 'jug pa dang / de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pas bsngo ba ste/ de ltar yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyis/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces bya bas rgyud dag par byas nas/ dngos gzhi sku'i rjes su gnang ba/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba/ thugs kyis rjes su gnang ba dang gsum du yod pa la/ dang po sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang / oṃ shu n+yā tā sogs brjod pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched thams cad gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar sogs mdun bskyed bzhin/ khyed rang rnams sogs tshig cung zad bsgyur/ khyed rang rnam pa re re yang de lta bu'i gtso 'khor lnga'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon la yang khyed rang rnams kyis bsgoms pa lta bu'i 'phags pa thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus drag po dung dung pa mdzad pa la brten nas/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kar phog de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'phags pa thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal lha lnga dpag tu med pa byon nas/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga dbang po'i sgo thams cad nas sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig snying po'i rjes su oṃ badz+ra a we sha ya āḥ.āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sogs mang du brjod cing rdor dril rol chen bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas khyed rnams kyi sdig sgrib dag sku'i dngos grub thob/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi sku sgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams 'phags pa thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gtso 'khor lngar gsal ba'i gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa gsal gdab/ slob dpon yang thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las/ mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du sngags kyi phreng ba zhal nas byung / khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar hrīḥyig gi mthar lan dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pas brtan par byas/ gsum pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod la gzungs ring lan gsum gyi rjes zlos gyis/ zhes brjod la rtsa sngags lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ bzlas lung thob pa'i yon du slob dpon la me tog gtor nas/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la bgo bar mdzod/ /ces lan gsum brjod du gzhug khyed rang gis phul ba'i me tog gi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te gtor bas rgyud byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni/

/'di la bgo bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /yang 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ so so'i ming brjod cing / bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'phags pa thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal yi dam du bzung bar bgyi'o/ /bla mas slob ma la me tog gtor te/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs nas/ brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol gyi bar dang / rig pa 'dzin pa dang rig pa 'dzin ma 'di rnams kyi thugs rgyud la thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig rig sngags dang gsang sngags thams cad kyang 'di rnams la 'jug par gyur cig des ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi dngos grub thob/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs sngags zab mo bzla ba la dbang ba yin no/ /gsum pa thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ slob ma la 'di ltar 'bogs te/ 'di ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /rig pas brtags na 'ga' ma rnyed/ /ma rnyed pa de don ma yin/ /ye nas gnas pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes pa ste/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang du lhod kyis lhod nas cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ bla mas slob ma la me tog gtor te/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs nas/ brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol gyi bar dang / rig pa 'dzin pa dang rig pa 'dzin ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la 'phags pa thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig des sems kyi dri ma dag thugs kyi dngos grub thob/

'phags pa thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la dbang ba yin no/ /rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi'i skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /rjes gnang zab mo zhus pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing / maṇ+ḍal du ma zad lus longs spyod thams cad kyang 'bul snyam pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /sogs brjod/ de nas slob ma gyes la/ mchod pa kha gso/ byin gyis brlabs/ mchod bstod byas la bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bdag la dgongs su gsol sogs kyis bzod gsol dang / oṃ pad+ma sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ pad+ma sa twa tā+e no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bhā wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+ta shrī ya ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān/ pad+ma mā me muñtsa/ pad+ma bhā ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ thugs rje'i phyag na pad+ma yis/ /yid kyi pad+ma kha phyes nas/ /rin po che ltar gshegs nas kyang / /tshur spyon thugs rje chen po muḥ mdun bskyed kyi tshom bu'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod cing bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni bya btang chos skyong bkra shis zhes bya ba chos snying nas byed pa'i gang zag des nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor kun dga' legs grub kyis mdzad pa la rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i 'di'i lugs kyi smyung gnas kyang kha bskangs te/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis chos bka' mi nub pa'i ched slob dpon las dang po ba rnams la lhag pa'i bsam pas sbyar ba'i dge bas 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang myur du zhi ba'i rgyur gyur cig/
